DENSITY_ORDERING_TAG

public static final java.lang.String DENSITY_ORDERING_TAG
This tag wraps the keyword defining the desired fluid density ordering flavour. There are 3:
"full"=fluids are density-ordered in permeable layers for the full extent of the model, even if two permeable layers are separated byan impermeable layer
"partial"= fluids are density-ordered in adjacent permeable layers not separated by an impermeable layer
"none"= all fluids are allowed in all layers, irrespective of density
